{{nihongo|'''Kansha Shrine'''|官舎神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ise Province]].

'''Kansha Shrine''' (かんしゃじんじゃ) is a shrine {{ill|Boca do Acre|bpy|বোকা ডো আক্রে|ce|Бока-ду-Акри|ceb|Boca do Acre (munisipyo)|eo|Boca do Acre|es|Boca do Acre|eu|Boca do Acre|fa|بوکا دو آکر|fr|Boca do Acre|hi|बोका दो अक्रे|hy|Բոկա դու Ակրի|it|Boca do Acre|ka|ბოკა-დუ-აკრი|kk|Бока-ду-Акри|mg|Boca do Acre|mzn|بوکا دو آکر|nl|Boca do Acre (gemeente)|no|Boca do Acre|pl|Boca do Acre|pt|Boca do Acre|ro|Boca do Acre|ru|Бока-ду-Акри|sv|Boca do Acre (kommun)|tt|Бока-ду-Акри|uz|Boca do Acre|vi|Boca do Acre|vo|Boca do Acre|war|Boca do Acre|zh|阿克雷港|zh_min_nan|Boca do Acre|qid=Q1793334}} in Obata-chō, {{ill|Ise, Mie|ar|إيسه|azb|ایسه، میه|bcl|Ise, Mie|be|Ісэ (горад)|ca|Ise (ciutat japonesa)|ce|Исе (гӀала)|ckb|ئیسێ|cs|Ise (Mie)|de|Ise (Mie)|eo|Ise (urbo)|es|Ise (Mie)|et|Ise (Jaapan)|eu|Ise (Mie)|fa|ایسه، میه|fi|Ise (kaupunki)|fr|Ise (Mie)|gl|Ise|hr|Ise|hy|Իսե (քաղաք)|id|Ise, Mie|it|Ise (Giappone)|ja|伊勢市|ka|ისე|ko|이세시|lt|Isė (Japonija)|mg|Ise|mzn|ایسه، میه|nl|Ise (Mie)|no|Ise (Mie)|pl|Ise (Japonia)|pt|Ise (Japão)|ro|Ise, Japonia|ru|Исе (город)|sh|Ise|simple|Ise, Mie|sr|Исе|sv|Ise, Japan|szl|Ise (Japůńijo)|tg|Исе|tl|Ise, Mie|tr|Ise (şehir)|tt|Исе (шәһәр)|uk|Ісе (Міє)|ur|ایسے، میہ|uz|Ise (Mie)|vi|Ise, Mie|war|Ise, Mie|zh|伊勢市|zh_classical|伊勢市|zh_min_nan|Ise-chhī|zh_yue|伊勢|qid=Q328067}}, {{ill|Mie Prefecture|Q128196|qid=Q128196}}. It is an {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and its former shrine rank was {{ill|Ken-sha|lt=prefectural shrine|qid=Q90139226}}. Originally it was called “Miyake Jinja,” but now it is called “Kansha Jinja” or “Rikyū-san”<ref>{{Cite web|title=官舎神社|url=https://genbu.net/data/ise/kansya_title.htm|access-date=2025-12-2}}</ref>.

=== History ===
It began in {{ill|Tenpyō-shōhō|Q1373169|qid=Q1373169}} 8, when {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kasuga Shrine}} in {{ill|Nara|ja|奈良|zh|奈良|qid=Q11444975}} was invited and enshrined as the {{ill|Oyagami|fr|Oyagami|ja|祖神|simple|Oyagami|qid=Q85882782}} of the {{ill|Nakatomi clan|ar|ناكاتومي|de|Nakatomi (Klan)|el|Αδελφότητα Νακατόμι|es|Clan Nakatomi|fa|خاندان ناکاتومی|fr|Clan Nakatomi|it|Clan Nakatomi|ja|中臣氏|ko|나카토미씨|nl|Nakatomi-clan|pl|Nakatomi (ród)|pt|Clã Nakatomi|vi|Gia tộc Nakatomi|zh|中臣氏|qid=Q1198447}}<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mie Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines: Kansha Shrine|url=http://kyoka.mie-jinjacho.or.jp/shrine/%e5%ae%98%e8%88%8e%e7%a5%9e%e7%a4%be/|access-date=2025-12-2}}</ref>. After falling into ruin in the medieval period, it was revived in {{ill|Kanbun (era)|Q1146228|qid=Q1146228}} 3<ref>{{Cite web|title=官舎神社|url=http://engishiki.org/ise/bun/is080151-01.html|access-date=2025-12-2}}</ref>. In {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 12 it became a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}. In Meiji 13, Obata Shrine (Yahashira Shrine) was merged. In {{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 19, it was promoted to prefectural shrine<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mie Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines|url=http://kyoka.mie-jinjacho.or.jp/shrine/%e5%ae%98%e8%88%8e%e7%a5%9e%e7%a4%be/|access-date=2025-12-27}}</ref>.
